description: Saves the associated audio in its original format.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: Listen to the sound of breaking glass, then save the MP3 file.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector of an audio element or a component implementing saveAudio(format, filename).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size preset forwarded to the trigger icon button: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant forwarded to the trigger icon button: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

methods.name: save(format: TpSaveAudioFormat = this.format): Promise<void>
methods.description: Requests the anchored component to save mp3, ogg or wav audio using filename. Resolves after completion or cancellation; does nothing when disabled or already saving. Invalid formats and incompatible targets reject.

events.name: tp-save-audio-error
events.description: Emitted when the target cannot be exported.

events.name: tp-save-audio-save
events.description: Emitted after an audio file has been saved.
events.detail: { format: "mp3" | "ogg" | "wav"; filename: string; anchor: string; target: Element }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-save-audio>` element saves the associated audio in its original format.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Save audio | Open or close the format menu. |
| MP3 / OGG / WAV | Choose an available format, then a filename, and save the audio. For an audio player, only the current source’s format is shown; unavailable formats are omitted. A check marks the current format. |
| Outside the menu | Close the menu. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused control or format. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the menu. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
